rows.title: Film Review: Andhadhun (2018) by Sriram Raghavan
rows.comment: Raghavan knows more than a thing or two about stylising and presenting his thrillers.
rows.verdict_le10: Raghavan knows more than a thing or two about stylising and presenting his thrillers.
